steps.en: Add Vue files under app/pages — each file is a URL
steps.zh: 在 app/pages 下放 Vue 文件，一个文件就是一个网址

steps.en: Generates the vue-router routes, code-splits per page and auto-imports components
steps.zh: 生成 vue-router 路由，按页面拆分代码，自动导入组件

steps.en: Write an API handler in server/api and fetch it from the page
steps.zh: 在 server/api 写接口，并在页面里取数

steps.en: Renders on the server and ships HTML plus a payload, so the browser hydrates without refetching
steps.zh: 服务器先渲染，HTML 附带 payload，浏览器不再重复取数

steps.en: Packages server and client for a Node server, serverless or edge platform, or static hosting
steps.zh: 把服务端和客户端打包成 Node 服务、Serverless/边缘包或静态站点

value.en: One Vue codebase serves SEO-ready server-rendered pages and its own API, deployable almost anywhere
value.zh: 一套 Vue 代码同时提供可被搜索引擎收录的服务器渲染页面和自己的接口，几乎能部署到任何地方

sources: README.md Getting Started ('npm create nuxt@latest <my-project>') and feature list (SSR/SSG/hybrid/edge rendering, automatic routing with code-splitting, auto imports, server/ directory, 300+ modules)
docs/1.getting-started/07.routing.md on branch 4.x (every Vue file in app/pages/ creates a route; routes generated for vue-router; pages/posts/[id].vue -> /posts/:id; code-splitting by default)

docs/1.getting-started/10.data-fetching.md on branch 4.x (useFetch / useAsyncData / $fetch; data forwarded to the client in the payload to avoid refetching during hydration; example useFetch('/api/data'))
docs/1.getting-started/13.server.md on branch 4.x (server powered by Nitro on h3; server/api/test.ts with defineEventHandler; 15+ deployment presets)
docs/1.getting-started/16.deployment.md on branch 4.x ('nuxt build' with the Node server preset; NODE_ENV=production node .output/server/index.mjs; port 3000; static, serverless and edge targets)
